desc:
🧟 Can you pull the 1 In 999,997,745 zombie?!

Welcome to Zombie Restaurant, where the staff bites back! 🧟 Build your own spooky restaurant, roll for insanely rare dishes, and turn your customers into your zombie crew!

🎲 Roll for dishes with crazy odds
🧟 Bite customers to recruit zombie staff
🏗️ Build and customize your own restaurant
🌙 Survive the night raids
💰 Serve customers and stack up cash
💤 Earn money AND roll mystery dishes while you're offline! Your restaurant never stops working.

🌍 New world events every 20 minutes! 🌕 Blood Moon, 🏴‍☠️ Pirate Tides, 🎬 Red Carpet, and more! Which event will happen next?


Game is new so there might be some bugs.

🎁Join JellyTrsh Studios to unlock the group rewards bonus in-game!
⭐ Enjoying the game? Like it and add it to your favorites so you don't miss future updates
